title: [bundle] Fix audit-found stale agent navigation docs/help: hf sync su
objective: Fix audit-found stale agent navigation docs/help: hf sync supports --json, but bare hf usage and FLEET_GUIDE still show hf sync [--auto] [--dry-run] without --json. Update help/docs and add/adjust tests so agents see the correct command surface.
acceptance_criteria: Bare hf usage/help includes `sync [--auto] [--dry-run] [--json]` so agents discover the JSON mode.
FLEET_GUIDE documents `hf sync [--auto] [--dry-run] [--json]` consistently with the CLI.
Regression tests assert the usage string exposes the sync --json option.
Drift audit passes: edits stay within claimed path_scope and the intent_lock is current.
